notes.title: Patch is available now
notes.content:
Hi friends,

In this patch we added the following:

- Steam Cloud saves support added.
Note: If there was a case when two or more Steam users have been playing this game on the same Windows account then game progress will be saved in cloud of the first logged in Steam user.

The following issues were fixed:
- Bridge increases time until next restored energy, instead of decreasing it
- Finishing the Rainbow Flower Collection doesn't mark it as complete
- Magic Chests called 'Healing Potion' drop incorrect items.
- Chest of the forest elves will drop a gold coin
- The chest of stone winds isn't dropping any rope ladders
- Timer for chests can be circumvented. Same link as the one just above.
- Various textual errors and typos, detailed in a post by Mickmane.
- Stone of Wisdom stops granting bonus XP after a while.

notes.title: The new update for the game is available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The following issues were fixed with this update:

- There are two achievements with the name "Collector", one for examining locations, the other for collections. Maybe the first one could be "Examiner".
- Game crashes when played for an extended period of time
- Save game profile lost
- Various textual errors and typos, detailed in a post by Mickmane
- There are two achievements with the name "Collector", one for examining locations, the other for collections. Maybe the first one could be "Examiner""
- Various people have reported problems, such as crashing during purchase, or not receiving what they have bought. Topic linked just above this one, also this one, and a few more can be found, most of them replied to by the devs
- Bug with the quest Stronghold Defenses. Quest text asks you to find 5 Heavy Swords and 5 Silver Arrows but to complete it it asks for 10 of each
- Description picture is Forest Cabin for Floating Isles
- Bug with mini-games when opening chests with sliding crystals/blocks when the game hangs
- The game supports German and Dutch languages now!

Thank you very much to you guys who maintain [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/392950/discussions/0/490121928342659931] this topic[/url] with all major game problems in it!

Thank you for playing this game.

notes.title: New update is available
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The following bugs were fixed:

- issue with screen tearing while scrolling the map
- In the Menagerie the HO item clover is typoed as "clever"
- When the timer expires during exploration the text says "The time is run out", it should say something like "Time has run out."
- The description of the bridges is misleading: "Increases energy replenishment speed for several seconds." In reality they decrease the time left until the next +1 energy by ten seconds per bridge.
- The description for both the ingame and Steam achievement "Mason" says "Investigated location: Stone Stone Quarry", having an extra "Stone" in it.
- The description for the Steam achievement "Firm" says "Increased max energy up to", which does not make sense without the context available for the ingame achievement. Could simply say "Increased max energy"
- The ingame achievement is described as "amulets purchased" but the game actually counts amulets used.
- fixed bug which possibly could cause loss of game's save
- The achievements tracking the number of times a location has been explored stop counting when level 5 mastery is reached. Not just a visual bug, the internal counter does not increase. Workaround: If you have not gotten to mastery level 5 anywhere, stop at mastery level 4, and simply keep exploring without getting a single star (almost letting the timer expire). This way the counter keeps increasing without you getting to level 5 mastery.
	
Improvements:
	- now you don't have to click on each dropped item to collect them, now it's sufficient just to move your mouse over an item 

Thank you very much indeed to everyone who is participating in reporting about this game problems here on Community Hub.

notes.title: Game update is available now!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Briefly:
- paid achievements were removed
- fixed issue which were preventing game launch on Win XP
- fixed bug when the game stops showing new quests

According to your feedback we've replaced 3 achievements that previously were requiring spending money to get them. Now you can get all the achievements without any purchases for real money.
Also those users who had troubles with game launch on Windows XP now can play the game on this OS also.

We are going to continue to work on improving your game experience and we will try our best to take into account each your negative review.
Thank you for playing our games.
